notes.title: Halloween "bewitched" content update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37899091/b010f547428bec17edadfa1f92ca5d1e1cc32b2a.png

Hello everyone,

we have a big content update for you today. ːsteamhappyː
So, let's head straight into the changes.

NEW LEVEL 05

https://media2.giphy.com/media/318IOhfELWNKW3bJ9T/giphy.gif?cid=790b761178ec90752791df75f091240b6e6e5702b352e638&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

The biggest change is our new spooky swamp level. The treats at the house may look tasty but beware the murky waters. If you stay in there too long, one of the tentacles may grab and pull you down.

NEW CHARACTER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37899091/d70407ce5db1fbc74f4571f4c60ee494a7e159d6.jpg

Behold the mighty dragon! Look at this fearful creature with his little piggy. The newest member of our failed fairy character cast. Come on, give him a hug and show him that the world ain't that scary!

READABILITY UPDATE

The readability of the game is always a big challenge. So with each patch we try to improve on this aspect. In this update we give you 2 major improvements.

https://media3.giphy.com/media/XkJxvNH143K9yDsbBi/giphy.gif?cid=790b761185658092854d92d37caec81be974832a0408f634&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

First, we added depth blur to the levels to make the play area pop out more and easier to read. This should help you get a better overview of all the chaos.
Second, we have the input prompts in the forest. You should now see input prompts for "Jump" and "Wall jump" when you approach the tree or the wall. This should help a new player get into the game.

NEW LEVEL SELECTION

https://media3.giphy.com/media/oxHKWkOdo2RyzUdwkt/giphy.gif?cid=790b76116fb23cfb9204c80ef0c6e4c88befbd5ef4311257&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

We also reworked our level selection to make it a bit easier to understand. That means it's now  compatible with the ONLINE multiplayer. No random levels anymore for the ONLINE mode.

Small changes:
Each phase now has a Timer.
9000 bug fixes
9000 asset fixes
9000 small improvements.

notes.title: v. 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Our next patch brings a bunch of visibility changes, online stability and UX improvements

1.0.2 Public Patch Notes:
- Fixed simultaneous scrolling in name input screen
- Temporarily removed bubble trap to fix design issues
- Adjusted camera speed
- Version Check for Online Games
- Display Version Number in Settings
- Fixed crash when joining midgame
- Fixed bug where input was not possible on gamestart

- Improved Lighting in Cliffs
- Improved visibility of Dolly
- Improved visibility of the Cauldron projectile
- Improved visibility of the FrostWand projectile
- Improved trampoline extra height on certain jumps, now happening less often

- Updated Credits
- Changed SceneLoader Sorting

- Added defaultName property to settings.json file, can be manually set to override random default names (this is a temporary workaround and might not work for everyone)

Carry on fairyfailing and let us know what you think about thos changes :)

notes.title: Fairyfail Release!!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/2kL8kPZ.jpg

Hello everyone,

We are really happy to present Fairyfail to you. It's been a long journey and there is still a lot to do. But now you can finally grab 4 Friends and crush them with your superior Platformer skills, both locally or online.

Here is a small list with features you can expect in the release version.

Build & Run

In Fairyfail you place a trap each round together with your friends 

https://media.giphy.com/media/zFAUiJ4aNASdwTWtuO/giphy.gif

And then try to make it through. So watch out to not make it too hard for yourself, but also not too easy for your enemies.

https://media.giphy.com/media/Z2Tj1FrBTOb67htSZo/giphy.gif

Online Mode

You can also crush your friends in Online mode. So it does not matter if your friends live in another country. Just grab some popcorn, join your favorite voice Tool, and watch your friends suffer the effects of your traps in real-time.

https://media.giphy.com/media/NGqLtGLY8vGsWgkE3T/giphy.gif

Quirky & whimsical characters

The name Fairyfail comes from our lovable failed Fairytale character. So here is a quick overview.

The Princess
https://i.imgur.com/kD4XFnC.png
Voiced by Lindsay Sheppard (IMDB)

The Knight
https://i.imgur.com/0PRxjQY.png
Voiced by Richard Reed (IMDB)

The Fairy
https://i.imgur.com/savGhxn.png
Voiced by Jessica Spencer (IMDB)

The Wizard
https://i.imgur.com/93OUJYy.png
Voiced by Marquiz Moore (IMDB)

Steam Achievements

Our artists also made some really nice looking Steam Achievements for you collectors out there. Here, take a look:

https://i.imgur.com/SwJa2WW.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/3HczZLj.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/MM0RrHc.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/tp2PCHZ.png

Fun to Watch

And in case all your friends are busy at the moment, you can watch other people play the Game. Because why not watch people on the internet struggle while you're comfortably snuggled in a blanket at home.
[previewyoutube=1dpmu-hNd0M;full][/previewyoutube]
If you want to help us make Fairyfail a better experience. Feel free to hit us up on Discord. We are open to feedback and want to develop the game together with the community. So if there is something you really want to see in Fairyfail in the Future, let us know! 


Yours,
TeraKnights & Gentleforge
